sources.label: Patches for Android TV apks
sources.author: ajstrick81
patch_list: Stops Tubi's analytics and tracking: Adjust, Branch, Braze, Nielsen, Conviva, NPAW/Youbora, Mux, Firebase/Google Analytics, Meta app events, and Tubi's own analytics endpoint (which receives your advertiser ID, device ID and ZIP/location f…
Suppresses all ad delivery systems in Tubi Android TV.

sources.label: Morphe patches for mobile phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and more.
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Stops the app's analytics, ad measurement, and marketing services.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Hides details about your phone from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Stops the app from asking you to sign in when you pause or leave a title.
Stops the app from asking you to update. A patched app cannot be updated through Google Play.
Plays the highest-resolution version of each title and live channel, at its highest bitrate. Turn it off if videos buffer.
Removes the Continue with Google sign-in option.
Removes the ads in videos, including ad breaks and image pause ads.
